label: D2 after a rewarded previous trial, late in the episode
explanation: Fires only at D2 (zero at D1 and GO), on about 37% of D2 steps. 91% of the activation mass falls on trials whose previous outcome, shown at this trial D1, was rewarded. The feature also grows strongly with episode time: the rate rises from 1.5% in trials 0-9 to about 20% in trials 70-99. D2 alone gives F1 0.54. Adding prev_reward==1 gives 0.64, and adding ep_trial>=40 gives 0.73 (mass recall 0.83). Magnitude is higher when S2 is reached and after a2, which is about 66% of the mass. Within a window it tends to ramp up over consecutive rewarded trials and drops out after an unrewarded one, so it looks like a slowly building reward-streak or confidence signal read out at D2. It never fires when the reward input is 1, which never happens at D2. It is weaker after switches. It uses only observed variables.
